notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.3.16
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent final altar from updating end game stage
[*] Fixed an issue that would block certain achievements from updating
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause UI from getting stuck during stealing skulls
[*] Fixed collision issue inside "Warehouse" that would allow players to climb on windows
[/list]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased [i]lens flare[/i] and [i]bloom[/i] intensity
[*] Adjusted volume levels for; [i]footsteps, cold state and freezing state[/i]
[*] Adjusted difficulty level; The "Cryptid" is now [b]much more aggressive[/b] and may rush towards players depending on stress stage
[/list]

notes.title: HIDEAWAY is out !
notes.content:
Happy New Year!
Join us in brand new scary winter horror co-op game and survive together!

Spend the night in a winter [b]Cabin[/b] with your friends and experience a scary winter folktale firsthand!

Don't mind the angry hairy thing roaming outside though,

otherwise you might get [b][i]frostbite[/i][/b]!


[h2]NEW VISUAL UPGRADE TO CELEBRATE NEW YEAR and EARLY ACCESS RELEASE:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Lit Snowflakes[/b]
    Snowflakes now gather light by the environment, they will [i]shine orange/yellow[/i] near fires & candles and they will [i]reflect bright white[/i] light inside your flashlight's range!
[/list]

-0-


[h2]PREVIOUS LATEST GAMEPLAY FEATURES & UPDATES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Cold Exposure[/b]
     Staying outside the [b]Cabin[/b] for a certain time will put you in [b]"cold" state[/b].
     In this state you will be slightly slowed down and your vision will be blurred slightly.
     [i][b]New related Achievement:[/b] Stay in "Cold Exposure" state for 10/20/30 minutes outside Cabin to unlock three new achievements![/i]
[*] [b]Frostbitten State[/b]
     [i]"Legend tells a story of a [i][b]Beast[/b][/i] that is so cold hearthed, when it touches anyone, they will be [b]"frostbitten"[/b] and freeze right in that moment."[/i]
     With this new challenge, if you ever get caught by the [i][b]Cryptid[/b][/i], you will then become "frostbitten", -an advanced version of the cold state- you will be slowed down considerably, your movement will become wobbly and your vision will blur considerably.
     You have to find shelter or a near heat source to warm up immediately.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41242360/97e3f7eb18e929cd8380a4555df5d129f0f4edf1.gif[/img]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41242360/58e359453ccda458f97026302800564b85b7245d.png[/img]

notes.title: One week left to launch!
notes.content:
It's that time of the year again.

Just the time for a [b]winter horror experience[/b]
New co-op horror game, HIDEAWAY, will be out as Early Access on New Year's Eve.

Get ready to face a bone chilling [i][b]Cryptid[/b][/i] in this constantly snowing land, with [b]new and updated achievements, new gameplay mechanic; "cold exposure"[/b] and [b]a new challenge; "frostbitten state"[/b].

[h2]NEW GAMEPLAY FEATURES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Cold Exposure[/b]
     Staying outside the [b]Cabin[/b] for a certain time will put you in [b]"cold" state[/b].
     In this state you will be slightly slowed down and your vision will be blurred slightly.

     [i]"Legend tells a story of a [i][b]Beast[/b][/i] that is so cold hearthed, when it touches anyone, they will be [b]"frostbitten"[/b] and freeze right in that moment."[/i]
     With this new challenge, if you ever get caught by the [i][b]Cryptid[/b][/i], you will then become "frostbitten", -an advanced version of the cold state- you will be slowed down considerably, your movement will become wobbly and your vision will blur considerably.
